subject: Your offer from Lumen Robotics!
body_text:
Hi Alex,

We are thrilled to extend an offer for the position of Senior Data Scientist at Lumen Robotics.

Location: Boston, MA

Please find your offer letter attached, along with details about compensation and start date.

Congratulations,
The Lumen Robotics Team
